anyOf.description:
Request schema for list_datasets with clear, unambiguous types.

Unlike its siblings, this schema does NOT parse JSON-string `filters`/
`select_columns` into lists — it relies on Pydantic's native list
validation instead. Preserved intentionally; see
test_list_datasets_with_string_filters.

certified.description: Use true to return only certified datasets (preferred for governed semantic-layer assets), false to return only uncertified datasets; omit to return both (default).

created_by_me.description: When true, return only items created by the current user. Can be combined with 'filters' but not with 'search'.

deleted_state.description: Surface soft-deleted (trashed) datasets: 'only' returns just trashed datasets, 'include' returns live and trashed datasets together. Omit for live datasets only (default). Trashed rows carry a non-null deleted_at and are limited to datasets the caller owns (admins see all); requires the SOFT_DELETE feature flag to have produced trashed rows.

edited_by_me.description: When true, return only items where the current user is listed as an editor. Can be combined with 'filters' but not with 'search'. Can be combined with 'created_by_me' to return items where the current user is either the creator or an editor.

filters.description: List of filter objects (column, operator, value). Each filter is an object with 'col', 'opr', and 'value' properties. Cannot be used together with 'search'.

items.description:
Filter object for dataset listing.
col: The column to filter on. Must be one of the allowed filter fields.
opr: The operator to use. Must be one of the supported operators.
value: The value to filter by (type depends on col and opr).

col.description: Filter column; see get_schema(model_type='dataset'). For people, resolve names to IDs with find_users; filter by created_by_fk or changed_by_fk with that integer ID.

opr.description: Operator to use. Use get_schema(model_type='dataset') for available operators.

value.description: Value to filter by (type depends on col and opr)

force_refresh.description: Invalidate cache and fetch fresh data

order_column.description: Sortable columns: id, table_name, schema, changed_on, created_on; changed_on_delta_humanized is an alias for changed_on.

refresh_metadata.description: Refresh metadata cache for schema changes

search.description: Case-insensitive substring search of schema, SQL, table name, and description. A complete UUID is an exact UUID lookup; or use a uuid filter. Compare candidate descriptions and metadata. Mutually exclusive with 'filters'.

select_columns.description: List of columns to select. Defaults to common columns if not specified.

request.description: Wrap {"request": {...}}; Do NOT pass search/page/filters top-level. Candidates, not a ranking: several fit? explain alternatives, clarify before querying; empty result doesn't prove absence. Never substitute out-of-scope data. Users: find_users ID filter, not search.

result.description:
Restore a soft-deleted dataset from trash.

Identify the dataset by numeric ID or UUID string (NOT table name). Only
datasets that were soft-deleted (moved to trash while the ``SOFT_DELETE``
feature flag was enabled) can be restored; permanently deleted datasets
are unrecoverable.

identifier.description: Dataset identifier - numeric ID or UUID string (NOT the table name).

result.name: restore_dataset
result.title: Restore dataset

result.description:
List the datasets and semantic views used by a dashboard's charts.

Look up the dashboard by ID, UUID, or slug. Each entry's datasource_type
distinguishes a table from a semantic_view, and name is its display name.

request.description: Dashboard lookup plus per-dataset detail caps.

result.name: get_dashboard_datasets
result.title: Get dashboard datasets

result.description:
List available metrics across built-in datasets and external semantic views.

This is the primary entry point for semantic layer exploration. Returns a
unified list of metrics from all data sources the current user can access,
with compatible dimensions embedded only on request.

dataset_id.description: Filter to metrics from a specific built-in dataset.

include_compatible_dimensions.description: Embed compatible dimensions only when explicitly requested. Use get_compatible_dimensions for the full per-metric list. When True, set page_size to at most 8, including built-in datasets.

search.description: Optional search string to filter metrics by name or description.

view_id.description: Filter to metrics from a specific semantic view.

result.name: list_metrics
result.title: List metrics

result.description:
Query SQL datasets only using saved metrics, dimensions and filters.

For semantic views, use list_metrics for discovery and get_table for queries.

Returns tabular data without requiring a saved chart.

cache_timeout.description: Cache timeout override in seconds (0 to disable)

columns.description: Column/dimension names for GROUP BY or SELECT (e.g. ['category', 'region']). Use get_dataset_info to discover available columns.

dataset_id.description: Dataset identifier — numeric ID or UUID string.

items.description: A single filter condition for dataset queries.

op.description: Filter operator. Use "==" for equals, "!=" for not equals, "IN" / "NOT IN" for membership, "IS NULL" / "IS NOT NULL", "LIKE" for pattern matching, "TEMPORAL_RANGE" for time filters.

val.description: Filter value (omit for IS NULL/IS NOT NULL)

force_refresh.description: Invalidate cache and fetch fresh data

metrics.description: Saved metric names to compute (e.g. ['count', 'avg_revenue']). Use get_dataset_info to discover available metrics.

order_by.description: Column or metric names to sort results by.

row_limit.description: Maximum number of rows to return (default 1000, max 50000).

time_column.description: Temporal column to apply time_range to. Defaults to the dataset's main datetime column.

time_range.description: Time range filter. Use Superset relative shorthands like 'Last 7 days', 'Last month', 'Last year', 'Last quarter', 'Current week', 'previous calendar year', or an ISO-8601 range like '2024-01-01 : 2024-12-31'. Requires a temporal column on the dataset. Bracket shorthands like '[year]' or '[quarter]' are also accepted and normalized to the equivalent 'Last <unit>' form.

result.title: Query dataset

config.description: Chart configuration. chart_type selects the chart type; call get_chart_type_schema(chart_type) for that type's fields and examples.

result.description: Save a SQL query as a virtual dataset so it can be charted.

request.description: Wrap as {"request": {...}}. Provide SQL and a dataset name. Use returned id as dataset_id in generate_chart or generate_explore_link; pick chart columns from returned columns.

items.description: Calculated column definition for dataset creation.

calculated_columns.description: Optional list of calculated columns to create. Each column must have 'column_name' and 'expression'.

catalog.description: Catalog to associate with the dataset (optional).

database_id.description: ID of the database connection to use. Use list_databases to find valid IDs.

dataset_name.description: Name for the new virtual dataset.

expression.description: Aggregate SQL expression for the metric, e.g. SUM(amount)

metrics.description: Optional list of saved metrics to create. Each metric must have 'metric_name' and 'expression'.

schema.description: Schema to associate with the dataset (optional).

sql.description: SQL query to save as a virtual dataset. Can be a JOIN, CTE, aggregation, or any valid SELECT.

result.description: Update existing chart with new configuration.

request.description: Wrap as {"request": {...}}. generate_preview=True previews; False persists immediately. MUST display explore URL. identifier: ID/UUID, NOT chart name. Omit config to rename only; add_columns appends table columns.

saved_metric.description: If true, 'name' refers to a saved metric from the dataset (use get_dataset_info to see available metrics). When set, 'aggregate' is ignored.

sql_expression.description: Custom SQL aggregate expression for an adhoc metric, e.g. 'COUNT(CASE WHEN closed_won THEN 1 END)::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(*),0)'. Metric-only — mutually exclusive with 'name', 'aggregate', and 'saved_metric'. Requires 'label'.

add_columns.description: Table columns or metrics to append while preserving every existing column and metric. Use this instead of config.columns when adding columns to an existing table chart.

cache_timeout.description: Cache timeout override in seconds (0 to disable)

config.description: Chart configuration. chart_type selects the chart type; call get_chart_type_schema(chart_type) for that type's fields and examples. Optional; omit to only update chart_name.

dataset_id.description: Target dataset ID to rebind the chart to a different dataset. When omitted, the chart retains its existing dataset. Can be combined with config to simultaneously change the dataset and visualization, or used alone to rebind without altering the config.

force_refresh.description: Invalidate cache and fetch fresh data

generate_preview.description: When True (default), returns a preview explore URL so the user can review changes before saving. When False, persists the update immediately.

preview_formats.description: Extra preview formats to render after saving. Only used when generate_preview=False. When generate_preview=True, the preview is always an explore URL.
